title: I’m a programmer but never made a game. I design, Claude Code writes all the code: Agewalker, a city builder you also walk through as the mayor (free playtest, Win/Mac)
author: from_makondo
selftext:
>I’m a programmer by trade, but games and game design are new to me. On this project I don’t write the code myself: I design the game and direct Claude Code, which writes all of it. That covers the Unity C# code, the Python scripts that build every 3D model in Blender, the code that synthesizes the sounds, and most of the translations.  
>  
>**The game:** you plan the town from above, then press Tab and walk through it in third person as the mayor. You collect taxes door to door, pick up ideas from thinkers and start research. Each age has its own tech tree, Forge of Empires-style. Version 1.0 is planned at 6 ages, from the Stone Age to the Aztecs. The free playtest covers the first two: the Stone Age and Sumer. Windows and Mac.

If anyone here has a good workflow for getting an AI to do the visual polish (lighting, post-processing, foliage), I’d love to hear it.
